moments.title: The Hundred Finals Day
moments.blurb: The Hundred cricket tournament culminates in its Finals Day at Lord's Cricket Ground this Sunday, featuring both the men's and women's finals.

angles.name: Cricket Excitement
angles.copy: Who's ready for some Finals Day drama? The Hundred reaches its climax this Sunday at Lord's! Get ready for a day of big hits and nail-biting finishes. #TheHundred

angles.name: London Event
angles.copy: Lord's is the place to be this Sunday! The Hundred Finals Day brings the best of 100-ball cricket to London. Who are you backing?

moments.title: Community Shield in Cardiff
moments.blurb: The FA Community Shield 2026 takes place this Sunday at Principality Stadium in Cardiff, with Premier League champions Arsenal facing FA Cup winners Manchester City.

angles.name: Football Season Opener
angles.copy: The traditional curtain-raiser for the football season is here! Man City vs Arsenal in the Community Shield this Sunday. Who's taking home the first silverware?

angles.name: Cardiff Hosting
angles.copy: Cardiff takes centre stage for the Community Shield this Sunday! Principality Stadium hosts Man City vs Arsenal. Are you heading to the capital?

moments.title: EFL Championship Season Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The 2026/27 EFL Championship season officially kicks off this Friday, August 14th, with matches running through the weekend.

angles.name: New Season Excitement
angles.copy: Football is BACK! The Championship season kicks off this Friday. Which team are you most excited to see in action?

angles.name: Wrexham's Return
angles.copy: It's a big weekend for Welsh football! The EFL Championship kicks off this Friday, and Wrexham are back in the mix. How far do you think they'll go?

moments.title: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean Still UK No.1
moments.blurb: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' remains at number one on the Official UK Singles Chart for a remarkable 20th week, as new entries from Ariana Grande and Tame Impala shake up the Top 40.

angles.name: Chart Domination
angles.copy: 20 WEEKS at Number 1! Sam Fender & Olivia Dean are still reigning supreme with 'Rein Me In'. Is it one of the biggest songs of the decade already?

angles.name: New Music Alert
angles.copy: New music alert! Ariana Grande, Tame Impala, and Luke Combs are among the new entries making waves on the Official UK Singles Chart this week. What's your favourite new track?

moments.title: Boomtown Fair Gets Underway
moments.blurb: The elaborate Boomtown Fair festival kicks off this Wednesday, August 12th, offering an immersive experience of music, arts, and theatre until August 16th.

angles.name: Festival Vibes
angles.copy: Boomtown Fair is almost here! Get ready for a week of incredible music, art, and immersive storytelling as the festival opens its gates this Wednesday. Who's heading to Chapter 3?

angles.name: Alternative Getaway
angles.copy: Escaping to a different world this week? Boomtown Fair is back from Wednesday, promising an unforgettable experience beyond just the music. What are you most looking forward to?

moments.title: Edinburgh Fringe Festival in Full Swing
moments.blurb: The world's largest arts festival, the Edinburgh Fringe, is currently in full swing across various venues in the Scottish capital, running until August 31st.

angles.name: Fringe Buzz
angles.copy: Edinburgh is buzzing! The Fringe Festival is well underway, bringing comedy, theatre, and art to every corner of the city. What hidden gems have you discovered so far? #EdinburghFringe

angles.name: Scotland's Cultural Hub
angles.copy: Our capital is a hive of activity with the Edinburgh Fringe taking over! From stand-up to experimental theatre, there's something for everyone. What's on your must-see list? #Fringe2026

moments.title: Reading & Leeds Festival Approaching
moments.blurb: Reading & Leeds Festival, one of the UK's biggest music events, is just over two weeks away, taking place from August 27th to 30th across both sites.

angles.name: Festival Countdown
angles.copy: The countdown is on! Reading & Leeds Festival is just weeks away. Who are you most excited to see on the lineup this year? #RandL26

angles.name: Leeds Excitement
angles.copy: Bramham Park is gearing up for Leeds Festival! Less than three weeks until the biggest party in Yorkshire kicks off. Have you got your tickets?

moments.title: Scottish Schools Return
moments.blurb: Many schools across Scotland are returning from their summer holidays this week, with some resuming as early as August 12th.

angles.name: Back to School Scotland
angles.copy: The summer holidays are winding down for many in Scotland! Good luck to all the pupils heading back to school this week. What's the best thing about going back?

angles.name: End of Summer Hols
angles.copy: Farewell to lie-ins! Scottish schools are back in session this week. Sending good vibes to students, teachers, and parents adjusting to the new term. #ScottishEducation

moments.title: Professor T Returns to ITV
moments.blurb: The acclaimed crime drama 'Professor T' starring Ben Miller returns for its fourth season on ITV this Wednesday, August 19th, at 9pm.

angles.name: New Series Alert
angles.copy: Professor T is back! Ben Miller returns as the brilliant, eccentric criminologist this Wednesday on ITV. Who's tuning in for the new season?

angles.name: Midweek Drama
angles.copy: Your midweek TV fix is sorted! Catch the return of Professor T on ITV next Wednesday. Get ready for more intriguing cases and unique insights.

moments.title: Happy 72nd Birthday, Joe Jackson

angles.copy: Wishing a Happy 68th Birthday to Feargal Sharkey on Thursday! From The Undertones' 'Teenage Kicks' to 'A Good Heart', his voice is unforgettable.
